_readme: HBuilderX cloud packaging config (cli pack). Fields map 1:1 to cli pack --help.
appid is still PENDING. Apply free at https://dev.dcloud.net.cn/
then log in to the same account inside HBuilderX.
Signing: this uses a LOCAL self-signed keystore (androidpacktype=0),
so it works together with safemode (the key never leaves this machine).
!! BACK THIS KEYSTORE UP. Lose it and the published app can never be updated.
NOTE: do not put ASCII double quotes inside string values, it truncates the JSON.
